note: NO VAUXHALL WEB OR CSS DESIGN TOKENS WERE OBTAINED. `tokens` is deliberately empty. www.vauxhall.co.uk returned HTTP 403 on a fresh re-test, and every candidate first-party asset host (assets./cdn./static./images./content./business.vauxhall.co.uk) returned DNS ENOTFOUND, so there is no un-WAF'd first-party host to read CSS from. Two further structural blocks apply, both new findings from this pass: (1) WebFetch converts HTML to markdown before any model sees it, which strips <link rel=stylesheet>, <style> and <script src>, so stylesheet URLs cannot be discovered from ANY html page in this run, reachable or not; (2) no browser means no computed styles, no resolved custom properties and no document.fonts. The values below are NOT design tokens and must not be promoted into research.json `tokens` without first-party corroboration. This is NOT PUBLISHED versus NOT FOUND versus NOT PROBED: the site is NOT REACHABLE, which is a different and weaker claim than either.
tokensNote: `tokens` stays EMPTY after the 2026-08-14 revision below, and deliberately so. First-party colour values were subsequently measured (see visual/color/palette.json) but they were measured from LOGO ARTWORK, not from a web surface. A web token is a value the site itself declares or renders. None was obtained, so promoting the logo hexes into this file would misdescribe where they came from. They belong to the visual dimension and they reach research.json from there.
colorEvidenceStatus: SUPERSEDED 2026-08-14. Both hexes below were DISPROVED as first-party values by direct measurement of four first-party logo PNGs, which render #eb0000 and #00003a. The entries are retained unchanged, because knowing what value circulates in the dealer and fan-wiki supply chain is useful when auditing third-party Vauxhall material. They must NOT populate any token. The contested-values reasoning that this file logged in observations.md was resolved in favour of SHARED ANCESTRY: two third-party sources agreeing exactly with each other while both differ from first-party artwork is the signature of one common upstream copy. This file's own suspicion was correct. Full record in visual/color/palette.json under `disproved` and `contradictions`.
